0022600100.text: The Pelicans, now 0-1 and 3rd in the Southwest, one game back, and 12th in the West, are playing their second game of the season, while the Utah Jazz are also 0-1 after a road loss and sit 5th in the Northwest and 15th in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but New Orleans won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 156-137 win in New Orleans on April 7, 2026. Utah will be without Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps), and Trey Alexander (knee), all listed as out.
